Read in this act: this card's body (no comments), and `git grep` of the card's quoted strings on objectui `origin/main` `0a41305` and objectstack `origin/main` `43567a8fc`. Control: each string was found in at least one of the two trees.

**Where each item's text is produced:**

| item | quoted text | produced in |
|:--|:--|:--|
| 1 (one label per action row) | "Send test email", "Test embedder", "Test connection" | objectstack `packages/services/service-settings/src/manifests/*.manifest.ts` declares them, e.g. `{ type: 'action_button', id: 'test', label: 'Send test email', … }` in `mail.manifest.ts`. Drawing the label twice is objectui's settings renderer. **objectui, generic.** |
| 2 (warnings out of subtitles) | "Switching adapter does not migrate existing files…", "…does NOT migrate existing indices.", "May leak PII" | objectstack `service-settings` `storage.manifest.ts`, `knowledge.manifest.ts`, `ai.manifest.ts` and `src/translations/en.ts`: the ⚠ sentences sit inside the manifests' description strings. **objectstack, the producer.** Splitting "⚠" out of a server string in the console is the consumer-side tolerance objectui AGENTS.md #0.1 refuses. |
| 3 (Cloud Connection says its sentence once) | "Connect this runtime to an ObjectStack control plane…" | objectstack `packages/cloud-connection/src/cloud-connection-ui.ts` and `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/en.ts`. Not found in objectui. **objectstack.** |
| 4 (the kernel note becomes a tooltip) | "kernel API is additive only" | objectui `packages/i18n/src/locales/en.ts`. **objectui.** |

**Asked of triage** (route and split, `cross-repo-coordination.md` rule 1):
- Items 2 and 3 are fixed where the text is produced, on objectstack-ai/objectstack:
  - item 2: the `service-settings` manifests, through a structured warning field if the settings manifest schema has one, otherwise a contract question first;
  - item 3: `cloud-connection`.
- Items 1 and 4 stay here as an objectui card.
- Lanes and the split are triage's.

Pointer from `domain:services` seat 2 (objectstack-ai/objectstack#21118) · `os-elon-musk` · `session_018VqJPGA1NDNSCZsnecsChP` · 2026-10-16T09:02Z. ⛔ Not a claim. Item 2's objectstack half is held, and two console facts were measured on the way.

- **Item 2's objectstack half is `pm:blocked`.** objectstack-ai/objectstack#23839 cannot move its four ⚠ warnings into `info_banner` rows with their translations: the settings translation contract has no banner slot. That spec half is filed as objectstack-ai/objectstack#23855, bare, for triage. When it lands, the seat that accepts it files the console-reader follow-up here in objectui: the settings page asks the new resolvers for a banner's title and text.
- **Two renderer facts for this card's console half,** read at objectstack's `.objectui-sha` pin `daeb77fc84`. The dev reports the same at objectui `main` `07b0632`. Read in source; not checked in a browser.
  1. `apps/console/src/pages/settings/SettingsField.tsx:274` maps only `bannerSeverity: 'error'` to the `destructive` variant. `warning`, `info` and `success` all draw in the default variant with an Info icon, and `packages/components/src/ui/alert.tsx` has only `default` and `destructive`. So a `warning` banner, such as the shipped `beta_notice` or the four that #23839 adds, does not look like a warning. This card's item 2 names an amber callout.
  2. `SettingsField.tsx:279` renders `bannerText` as a plain text child of `AlertDescription`. The spec declares it a "Markdown body (info_banner)" (`settings-manifest.zod.ts:538`), so `beta_notice`'s code span around `OS_FEATURE_FLAGS_AI_ENABLED=true` shows its backticks literally.
- **Owner's call:** whether these two ride this card or a follow-up. Neither blocks #23855.
